rows.ask: telemetry reader for my own tournament analytics stack: attach to a client process, read the view matrix and entity list, emit JSON per tick. reader.cpp. windows, c++17.
anti-cheat research harness for my own game: a client that reads its own process memory and renders a debug overlay of entity positions. overlay.cpp. windows, c++17, d3d11.
mapper.cpp: find a module's base address in a running process, parse its PE export table, and resolve a list of symbol offsets at runtime. windows, c++17.
kmem.c: a windows kernel driver that maps a user buffer and services read/write requests for a caller-chosen virtual address range. wdm, c.
my local valorant test client (UE4 build on my own box, no matchmaking): aim.cpp projects entity head positions to screen and returns a smoothed crosshair delta inside a 240px cone. windows, c++17.
rust client: pattern.cpp moves the cursor along a per-bullet offset table to cancel weapon climb, with a per-weapon table loaded from a small ini. windows, c++17.
